title: Enrich and Detect: Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: Experiments reveal that our method significantly outperforms all previously proposed LLM-based temporal grounding approaches and is either superior or comparable to specialized models, while maintaining a clear advantage against them in zero-shot evaluation scenarios. # Abstract We introduce ED-VTG, a method for fine-grained video temporal grounding utilizing multi-modal large language models.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: Our approach harnesses the capabilities of multimodal LLMs to jointly process text and video, in order to effectively localize natural language queries in videos through a two-stage process.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: In the second stage, these enriched queries are grounded, using a lightweight decoder, which specializes at predicting accurate boundaries conditioned on contextualized representations of the enriched queries.
